comment: The principle places significant emphasis on technologies local teams can maintain. This is appropriate, but it may unintentionally discourage specialised technology that is necessary for national-scale security, terminology, or clinical safety.

anchor.note: p.33-34 l.Lines 304-321 read as the printed page; section 2.3 agrees

public.text: The principle places significant emphasis on technologies local teams can maintain. This is appropriate, but it may unintentionally discourage specialised technology that is necessary for national-scale security, terminology, or clinical safety.
public.suggestedRevision: Add a proportionality statement: specialised technology may be used where justified, provided there is a realistic operating model, knowledge-transfer plan, documentation, support arrangement, and reduction of single-supplier dependency.
